usedFor: A fully signed Docusign envelope opens a deal in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Envelope Completed” in Docusign, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Completed means everyone has signed, unlike “New Envelope Created”, which fires before anything is signed.

watchOut: Wire only one Docusign trigger to “Create Deal”, or one envelope opens a deal at each stage.
